body.title: Resolve the companion header
body.summary: Add CompanionHeader to types.ts and a header module that resolves projectName (.insrc/config.json projectName, else repo basename), workItemId via safeCanonical with storyId/epicHash fallback, sourceDoc {id, href}, an injected-clock date 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm', user (git user.name, else OS login, else 'unknown') and the context line per source kind (HLD summary / DEF Story statement / standalone story title + LLD summary / placement only). Never throws.
acceptanceChecks: projectName override and basename fallback both work; a malformed config is ignored.
git, OS and 'unknown' user fallbacks work with stubbed lookups.
Malformed createdAt/epicHash/storyId yields the plain id fallback without throwing.
Context line matches each source kind.

tests.name: header: projectName override / basename fallback / malformed config ignored
header: git user / OS fallback / 'unknown'; injected clock format
header: malformed createdAt/epicHash/storyId -> plain id fallback, no throw
header contextLine: HLD / epic-Story LLD / standalone LLD / placement-only
